headline: Amber Enterprises India Limited: Amalgamation/Merger
sum: Amalgamation/Merger — Pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI LODR Regulations, we hereby inform the exchange that the Company has received an order dated 03rd July 2026, passed by Hon'ble National Company law Tribunal, Chandigarh Bench in CP…
detail: Amalgamation/Merger — Pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI LODR Regulations, we hereby inform the exchange that the Company has received an order dated 03rd July 2026, passed by Hon'ble National Company law Tribunal, Chandigarh Bench in CP (CAA) No. 18/Chd/Pb/2026 connected with CA(CAA) No. 11/Chd/Pb/2026 received by the Company on 15th July 2026. The said order in relation to the scheme is annexed in the disclosure.
